中国经济.content: The PBoC reported a 20t increase in gold reserves in July (Chart 4), bringing official gold holdings to 2,366t, 8% of total foreign exchange reserves. Following the largest monthly addition since October 2023, the PBoC’s gold-buying streak has now reached 21 months, the longest on record.
